rules.title: Release Agent Tank Low Level
rules.root_cause: Release agent consumption outpaced the refill interval and the tank level fell below the low level switch.
rules.device_description: Level switch low, release agent tank
rules.interlock_effect: Inhibits spray cycle; mould held at station.
rules.recommended_action: Refill the release agent tank and confirm LSL-112 clears at JB-110 before resuming the spray cycle.

rules.title: Compressed Air Header Low Pressure
rules.root_cause: Header pressure sagged below the pneumatic actuator minimum, typically after a compressor trip or a large leak downstream of the dryer.
rules.device_description: Pressure switch low, compressed air header
rules.interlock_effect: Inhibits pneumatic cleaning brushes and lid actuators.
rules.affected_output_description: Brush and lid valve manifold enable
rules.recommended_action: Check compressor status and the header isolation valve; inspect the filter-regulator unit near JB-104 for leaks.

rules.title: Guard Gate Open During Manipulator Cycle
rules.root_cause: The access gate interlock switch opened while the cage manipulator was running in automatic cycle.
rules.trip_condition: Gate switch open while cycle active
rules.device_description: Guard gate safety switch, manipulator cell
rules.recommended_action: Clear the cell, close and latch the gate, then acknowledge and reset the safety circuit at the cell panel.

rules.title: Cage Presence Not Confirmed
rules.root_cause: The photoelectric sensor did not detect the reinforcement cage after the placement step completed.
rules.recommended_action: Verify the cage is seated in the mould; clean the PE-220 lens and check alignment with its reflector.

rules.title: Mould Vibrator Motor Overtemperature
rules.root_cause: The winding thermistor on vibrator group B exceeded its trip temperature after extended duty or blocked cooling fins.
rules.device_description: Winding temperature switch, vibrator group B
rules.interlock_effect: Stops vibrator group B; holds pour sequence.
rules.recommended_action: Allow group B to cool, clear concrete build-up from the motor housings and review the vibration duty time.

rules.title: Concrete Hopper Low Level
rules.root_cause: Hopper inventory is insufficient for a full segment pour.
rules.interlock_effect: Inhibits next pour start; raises batch request.
rules.recommended_action: Confirm the batch request reached the mixing plant and check LT-305 for material build-up on the probe.

rules.title: Hopper Discharge Gate Failed to Close
rules.root_cause: The closed-position switch was not made after the close command; aggregate may be jamming the gate blade.
rules.trip_condition: Closed position not reached within 3 s
rules.device_description: Position switch closed, hopper discharge gate
rules.recommended_action: Stop the feed, clear the obstruction and verify ZS-309 actuation before re-enabling carousel advance.

rules.title: Emergency Stop Pressed, Finishing Platform
rules.root_cause: An operator pressed the emergency stop pushbutton on the finishing platform.
rules.interlock_effect: Safe stop on carousel main drive.
rules.affected_output_description: Carousel main drive safe torque off
rules.recommended_action: Confirm the hazard is cleared, release the ES-402 pushbutton and reset the safety relay at the operator pulpit.

rules.title: Steam Valve Position Feedback Mismatch
rules.root_cause: Valve position feedback deviates from the commanded position, which points to a sticking actuator or loss of instrument air.
rules.device_description: Position transmitter, zone 2 steam control valve
rules.interlock_effect: Closes zone 2 steam isolation valve; holds tunnel advance.
rules.recommended_action: Stroke-test the zone 2 valve, check the positioner air supply and verify ZT-512 wiring at JB-512.

rules.title: Tunnel Humidity Below Setpoint
rules.root_cause: Relative humidity in the tunnel dropped below the curing setpoint.
rules.interlock_effect: Starts fogging nozzles; flags quality hold on batch.
rules.recommended_action: Inspect fogging nozzles for blockage, check the tunnel door seals and review the affected batch before release.

rules.title: Vacuum Lifter Low Vacuum
rules.root_cause: Vacuum level at the lifter pads is insufficient for a safe lift.
rules.interlock_effect: Inhibits lift command; keeps segment in mould.
rules.recommended_action: Inspect pad seals and the segment surface for debris; check the vacuum pump and hose couplings.

rules.title: Turning Device Motor Thermal Overload
rules.root_cause: The thermal overload relay tripped on the turning device motor.
rules.device_description: Thermal overload relay, turning device motor
rules.interlock_effect: Stops rotation; blocks stacking crane entry.
rules.recommended_action: Let the motor cool, check for mechanical binding on the turning frame, then reset OL-705 in CP-07.
